ClientMessage.description: {"type": "play"|"pause"|"step"|"speed", "value": multiplier}  (speed 0 or >= 100 means as fast as possible).
ClientMessage.title: ClientMessage

DeathDTO.description: How a run ended in death: where, and what did it. `object_type`/`label` name the thing (null for "other").
DeathDTO.title: DeathDTO

DialView.description: One knob of a fly as the dials switch sees it: where evolution left it and where the hand-set original sits.
DialView.title: DialView

FlyView.description: A fly as the server returns it: the FlyDTO plus, for every knob any plug-in declares, its dial.
FlyView.title: FlyView

FrameEvent.description:
One frame. The game picture and the overlay are separate layers; `rates` is the light state (0..1 per
neuron group).
FrameEvent.title: FrameEvent

KnobChange.description: What evolution did to one knob, in words ("a bit toward strong"); never a number.
KnobChange.title: KnobChange

KnobUI.description: A knob as the UI sees it: a slider. `position` is the default (in a registry entry) or the fly's setting.
KnobUI.title: KnobUI

MomentSave.description: Save a moment of a running run. `frame` None = now; else one of the recent in-memory snapshots.
MomentSave.title: MomentSave

MomentSummary.description: A saved moment without its emulator/brain bytes.
MomentSummary.title: MomentSummary

ObjectOnScreen.description: An object the senses looked at this frame. `box` is in level pixels, like `mario`.
ObjectOnScreen.title: ObjectOnScreen

StartResult.description: One dev-set start: how the fly did from it.
StartResult.title: StartResult

TestScene.description: A ready-made test situation built from a scene modifier and an object type.
TestScene.title: TestScene

TryDTO.description: One run resumed from a moment. `change` is the fly's difference from the moment's fly, in words only.
TryDTO.title: TryDTO

VideoCheck.description: What a replay did against what was recorded; hash_ok is None when nothing was recorded to compare with.
VideoCheck.title: VideoCheck

VideoRequest.description: Asks for an export: it renders in the background and the mp4 is ready when the status says finished.
VideoRequest.title: VideoRequest

post.description: The brain and nerve cord with the neuron groups this fly uses lit: the Fly page's mini map.

schema.title: Response Fly Presets Flies Presets Get

get.description: The best fly of one generation (-1 = the fly evolution started from): start a run with it to watch it.

post.description: "Use this fly": save the evolution's best fly as a new fly yaml, with where it came from.

get.description: The level's opening screen (256 x 208 PNG); made with the emulator the first time, then cached.

schema.title: Response Moment Tries Moments  Moment Id  Tries Get
Response Run Moments Runs  Run Id  Moments Get

post.description: Render an export in the background; poll GET /videos/{id} until it is finished, then fetch its video.

get.description: The mp4. Plain, it plays in the page; with ?download=true the browser saves it as <id>.mp4.
